description: Reads one order, named by its ord_ id: everything the list of orders shows, the messages each line and field was read from, the payment screenshots read for it (a screenshot alone does not mark it paid), the customer’s change requests, and every change made to it: who, when, and from which message or tap, also as a timeline newest first with where each change came from. With it: the customer’s record on that number (earlier orders, returns, total spent, saved addresses, tags, the chat’s notes and link), the delivery place on a map, and the payment link sent and the provider’s reference. Read-only.
